g.text: Minutes of the committee meeting, 14 March 2026
Present: R. Okafor (chair), M. Lindqvist, D. Haddad, S. Moreau.
The committee agreed to rebuild the summit cairn on Raven Ridge before 1 June.
The work party will meet at the north gate at 07:30 on Saturday 9 May.
Budget approved for the season: 2,450 euros, of which 600 for new signage.
S. Moreau | update the website | 23 May
